INDUSTRIAL STRUCTURE AND DEVELOPMENTS Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sales in the country were expected to grow by 6% to 8% in terms of revenue during the ﬁnancial year 2026-27., reﬂecting steady demand and consumption patterns.
Growth & demand: The market size is projected to reach INR 398.71 billion by 2027, driven by rising consumer preferences for indulgent snacks, innovative product launches, and increasing urbanization.
According to the IMARC Group, the Indian confectionery market is anticipated to reach INR 618.10 billion by exhibiting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 4.99% during the period 2026-2034 .

Further, the Company's income from exports (including deemed exports) registered signiﬁcant growth, rising from ₹678.92 lakhs in the previous year (2024-25) to ₹3873.46 lakhs in the current year (2025-26).
